_doc: The law: 申报 is banned from user-facing Chinese copy. A native reader hears a
TAX or CUSTOMS declaration (申报纳税, 海关申报) — a self-report filed under legal
compulsion. An SEC 10-K, a 13F, a congressional STOCK Act report is a 披露, a
disclosure published to the market. Swept by hand twice before this gate existed:
PR #4830 (Filing Forensics) and PR #4855 (SEC / 13F / congress copy, site-wide).
`allow` licenses an EXACT PHRASE on an EXACT FILE — never a whole file. An
occurrence is exempt only when it falls inside a licensed phrase's span in a
licensed file; a bare 申报 elsewhere on the same line still fails, and the same
phrase in another file still fails. Both invariants are pinned by --selftest.
`pending` is the temporary half: a file whose 申报 is already being removed by an
open PR. `max_occurrences` freezes today's count as a ratchet — MORE fails hard,
fewer prints a ::notice asking for the entry to be tightened or dropped. Never
add a pending entry without an open PR that provably removes the term.

allow.why: Jobless CLAIMS, not a securities filing. 申报失业金 is 'to file for unemployment benefits' — the citizen-to-state declaration sense, which is precisely correct for the BLS initial-claims holiday-week quirk this string describes. 披露 would be wrong here.
allow.site: release quirk `claims_holiday_week`, zh copy for the BLS initial-claims holiday-week adjustment (DOL ETA 5159)

allow.why: SSE/HKEX order-entry term of art ('buy order entry'), not a disclosure. It appears in TITLE_EXCLUDE, the scraper's negative filter for exchange announcements about trading mechanics — upstream exchange vocabulary this platform matches on, never copy it authors.
allow.site: TITLE_EXCLUDE tuple, alongside 波动调节 / 竞价 / 额度 / 风险提示

pending.why: The landing page's filings copy (盯紧申报, 打开申报台席, 申报即录, ...). Open PR #4765 rewrites all 9 to native-Chinese phrasing and its head carries 0 — verified 2026-08-07 against refs/pull/4765/head. Fixing it here instead would collide with that PR on a plain-copy PAIRED asset (templates/index.html must byte-match site/index.html), which is the two-partial-heals deadlock the house law warns about. Drop this entry once #4765 lands.
